name: Choir of Blades [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your mastery of your people’s martial styles extends to training, and you can share your skills with your allies, even though they lack your many long years of formal training.

Benefit(s): Allies adjacent to you of an ancestry different from your own gain the following benefits. If you have an ancestry bonus on attack rolls against a particular creature type or subtype, your ally also gains that bonus. If you have ancestral arms, weapon familiarity, or any other ancestral trait that grants weapon proficiencies, your ally also gains those proficiencies.
